full_details: In the morning you looked at the lovers' dawn that was already written, down to the line of the woes, and you shut it. You did not fair it, and you did not tie it, and you did not write a new line. At seven John Florio called from my lord's house in Holborn. The house was in black. Sir Thomas Heneage died this day at the Savoy. He was Vice-Chamberlain and Treasurer of the Chamber, and husband these eighteen months to my lord's mother. My lord is with her. There is a remedy for everything but death. You sent your duty and asked nothing. Then you asked who signs. A widow must first cast up the dead man's accounts. After that, who knows. He has not forgotten the Chaucer, and he will send it when the house is quieter. You did not pretend to have lost a friend. Nor did he. Downstairs, Mistress Ansell asked only whether the great man made a good end. You were not told the manner. You went up and wrote one line for Heminges.
one_sentence: You shut a dawn already written, and at seven in the evening Florio said Sir Thomas Heneage had died that day.
title: The house in black, and one line
